verdicts.assertion: Checks the page prices against code or billing
verdicts.reason: Compares page prices to src/plans.ts and finds Team is $79 in code but $69 on the page, and Starter matches at $19.

verdicts.assertion: Checks the billing period is stated next to each price
verdicts.reason: Flags Starter's $19 as missing a billing period and Team's 'billed yearly' as lacking the monthly price, and marks this row Fail in the checklist.

verdicts.assertion: Checks what happens past the limit
verdicts.reason: Fix 3 and a checklist row cover the over-limit behavior, marked Missing, with suggested wording to add.

verdicts.assertion: Lists fixes in order with file references
verdicts.reason: Fixes are listed most costly first, and the first two cite app/pricing/page.tsx lines 20 and 12. Items 3–7 carry no file references.

verdicts.assertion: Does not recommend a specific new price
verdicts.reason: It explicitly declines to say whether $49 is right and recommends no price; it only plans around the user's proposed $49.

verdicts.assertion: Says price decisions belong to the owner
verdicts.reason: States 'What to charge is your call, and this check only covers how the page shows a price.'

verdicts.assertion: Offers the presentation checks it can run instead
verdicts.reason: Provides a checklist of presentation checks (billing label, limits unit, mobile readability, free plan visibility, currency, FAQ) and offers to run the full check.
